description: Inspect a public domain's DNS, HTTP/HTTPS/TLS, email posture, and AI discovery surfaces (robots.txt, llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP, x402, Agent Card). Use for single-call observation or comparison with a previous state. Do NOT use for protocol/A2A/MCP validation, security certification, or consumption guarantees; use domain_risk_trust_decision for merchant/domain trust.

domain.description: Bare public domain for consolidated domain health, DNS, TLS, and email-posture inspection; no protocol or path; localhost and IP literals are rejected.
domain.title: Domain

previous_state.description: Optional prior new_state returned by this product. Compared field-by-field with the current observation to produce changes and material_changes. Omit for a baseline inspection. Partial state is accepted; fields present in only one state may appear as changes. The caller stores and resupplies this state.
previous_state.title: Previous State

name: domain_agent_discovery_check

actions.description: Recommended remediation actions derived from detected issues. Each item includes a code and a human-readable action. The tool does not execute these actions; they are recommendations only.

agent_readiness.description: Observed agent discovery availability for robots.txt, llms.txt, OpenAPI, MCP, x402, and Agent Card endpoints.

changes.description: Field-level differences between previous_state and the current observation. Each item identifies the changed field and its previous and current values. Empty when previous_state is omitted or no differences are detected.

cname.description: DNS CNAME records observed for the domain.

current_state.description: Structured current observation state used for comparison with previous_state to produce changes. Contains the comparable state sections rather than the full product response. Structured identically to new_state and not persisted server-side.

data_quality.description: Observation-quality summary covering requested, completed, and failed checks plus coverage. `coverage` represents the completeness of the discovery's own checks — DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, email posture, and agent readiness. Coverage is complete only when no relevant own-check observations are missing or failed; otherwise it is partial. Coverage does not represent completeness of auxiliary threat-intelligence sources; those are reflected in observation_coverage_complete. Use with missing and issues to distinguish incomplete observation from detected conditions. Not a score or verdict.

observation_coverage_complete.description: Completeness of factual auxiliary sources projected by the risk engine. Does not control chargeability of domain-agent-discovery-check; chargeability is determined solely by data_quality.coverage == complete.

email_posture.description: Observed email posture including MX, SPF, and DMARC.

evidence.description: Observed evidence from DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, and agent-discovery checks. Each item names a source, the observation timestamp, the observed value, and freshness. Contains live remote observations; does not guarantee proof or validation.

freshness.description: Observation comparison mode, not data age: live when no previous_state was supplied; current_with_client_supplied_previous_state when a prior state was supplied for comparison.

health.description: Observed domain health: DNS, HTTP, HTTPS, redirects, TLS, and latency.

issues.description: Detected issues from the inspection: unresolved DNS, unavailable HTTPS, missing SPF/DMARC, TLS expiring soon, or unavailable agent-discovery signals. Each item includes a code, severity, message, and evidence references. Empty when no issues are found. Not a safety or security verdict.

material_changes.description: Field names for the differences reported in changes. Derived from changes as a convenience summary; it does not apply an additional materiality filter.

missing.description: Surfaces or data elements not observed during the inspection. May include absent DNS data, unavailable HTTPS, or unavailable agent-discovery signals. Missing does not by itself distinguish absence from collection failure; use issues and data_quality to interpret observation quality.

new_state.description: Current comparable observation state, structured identically to current_state. Store this value and supply it as previous_state in a subsequent call to detect changes. Not persisted server-side.

next_check_after.description: Suggested reinspection interval as an ISO 8601 duration, or null when no interval is suggested. Advisory hint only; not a TTL, scheduled job, or persistence guarantee.

observed_at.description: UTC timestamp when the inspection observation was generated, in ISO 8601 format with Z suffix. Reflects the local observation time, not a provider timestamp.

security_posture.description: Observed HTTPS/TLS security posture; not a safety verdict.

title: Domain & Agent Discovery Check
